newsitem.title: USA: Caribiner buys London communications firm.
newsitem.headline: Caribiner buys London communications firm.

text.p: Caribiner International Inc said on Thursday that it had acquired WCT Live Communication Ltd, a privately held, London-based business communications company, for about $11.7 million in cash and stock.
The transaction, consisting of roughly $10.1 million in cash and $1.6 million in Caribiner stock, builds on Caribiner's existing London operations, acquired a year ago.
WCT Live had revenue of $17.6 million for the 12 months ended September 30, 1996, Caribiner said in a statement.
Caribiner International Inc provides training programs and business communications services.
